subject: finance.budget
name: Budget 2026-2027 tax and revenue measures as enacted
what_would_settle_it: The 128-page Finance Bill 2026. Three fetch paths into the National Assembly's bills library returned an HTML shell rather than the document; the library is script-rendered and exposes no static file path, so this needs a browser rather than an automated fetch.
disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at four across the three units

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National sovereign compute capacity
what_would_settle_it: Vendor or independent confirmation of installed accelerators. The state operator's chief executive stated in July 2026 that its data centre already hosts NVIDIA H200 units with B300 due by end-2026; no corroboration is on file, and this is precisely the compute-timing bet a domestic critique disputes.
disposition: probed 2026-08-09: no vendor or independent confirmation found, and the probe turned up the opposite side of the claim. The same chief executive wrote on 22 February 2026, after the New Delhi summit, that Mauritius is requesting a few hundred B300 units and was quoted a lead time of about one year — which the wiki does not hold and which sits against the July statement that current-generation units are already installed. Acquisition line raised.
